Name: Monty
Dialog: This was nice.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, I'm glad we ran into each other.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Yeah, almost literally -  you barely missed me with your scooter.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Laughs) What can I say? You walk slow. So, uh, what are you doing tonight?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Yeah, I'm gonna see Love Sandal. It's a Love Händel cover band that, uh, that plays in, in sandals. My- my cousin plays bass, he can get us backstage, it'll be fun. You wanna come?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Uh, no, no I don't. I'll catch you later.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Keep an eye out for that scooter.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Carl...

Name: Monty
Dialog: Go ahead.

Name: Carl
Dialog: You mean there's more?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Look, you don't have to tell my dad about this, do you?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Monty, Monty. Walk with me. You know your dad is my superior. I'm obliged to tell him everything. I can't imagine what could possibly sway me to consider such a dereliction of duty.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Alright, Carl, I get it, what do you want?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I want your father to disown you, and adopt me.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Okay, what do you want within reason?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Y-You don't understand. I do all the work at the agency, but he doesn't even acknowledge me. I mean that's all I want, a simple "Thank you" is that too much to ask?

Name: Monty
Dialog: You just want him to say "Thank you"?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes, a simple "Thank you."

Name: Monty
Dialog: Carl, if-if that's all you want, then I'm sure I can get Dad to say "Thank you" to you.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, if you can do that, maybe I can just forget to mention the whole "dating a sworn enemy's daughter" thing.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Deal.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Ferb, check out this cool picture of Grandma and Grandpa Flynn in their pyramid water skiing days. Wow. It's all the fun of water skiing times ten. You know, I bet you pyramids would make any sport better. Ferb...

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you two think you're—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (using the mic dropped down from the tree) **I KNOW WHAT WE'RE GONNA DO TODAY!!!!**

Name: Candace
Dialog: —doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (sounds slightly muffled) Oh, hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I said, "Hey, Candace."

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! I can't hear you over all this ringing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry about it. It'll go away in a sec. See ya' later, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I may not be able to hear you, but I can see you! If you stay in range!

Name: Off-Screen Voice
Dialog: (From her second story window overlooking the backyard) (Laughs) Oh, Candace, right on schedule.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uhh, hi. Are you new here?

Name: Woman
Dialog: Heavens no, dear, I've been here all summer. I've so enjoyed watching your brothers build so many amazing things everyday.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh that's perfect. Uh, you know what? My arms are getting really tired, just hold that thought, I'll be right back. (runs off, and returns with a step ladder) You were saying?

Name: Woman
Dialog: They're so inventive. I mean they built that rollercoaster, oh, and that spa, and I loved that platypus-themed restaurant, even though I couldn't get a reservation. The bouncer was so harsh. (While saying this, Candace smiles widely) Oh, but the best was when they had their own sitcom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, I wasn't even here for that one.

Name: Woman
Dialog: I know, but I wouldn't miss a minute of witnessing your brothers' backyard fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Lady, you've got to help me! You've got to come down here and tell my mom all about it!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Oh, I don't think so, dear. Um, I just don't feel up to leaving the house.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No problem. You stay right where you are, and I'll bring my mom over! (Starts to leave but comes back) Heeheeheeheehee...

Name: Woman
Dialog: Oh, by the way...

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Woman
Dialog: Where's Perry?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Hey Dad.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Monty my boy. It's always wonderful to see you.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Hello sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, what took you so long? Hand me that report there would you?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: My coffee! Huh, thanks Monty.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Uhh actually Carl-

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, the trash chute is clogged again, do you mind?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Of course not sir. (He makes his way past Monty and Major Monogram) Pardon me. Excuse me. Coming through

Name: Monty
Dialog: Tsk uh, Dad, Agent P is here.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, so he is. Good morning Agent P. Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been spotted on his balcony repeatedly shaking his fist and then running back into his building. Which is obviously evil. Well, okay maybe not evil, but definitely cliché. So, go and stop him from his cartoon conventions.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Here's how you play!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I don't care if it's played in a field or on a court,

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: 'Cause everyone here is into pyramid sports!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I think I pulled my sigmoid colon.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Annoying musician. C-Come on. Come on. Come to papa. Ah! Bingo! Eh- (Perry puts his tail in front of the scope) Hey what's with the waffle? Oh very funny Perry the Platypus, very funny. If-If you'll just be so kind as to move your tail out of the way. (Perry does so) Thank you, thank you. There we go. That's good, an-uh- (Perry puts his tail in front of the scope again) See now you're just being childish. Look, I promise you. I'm not even being marginally evil. I just want to stop that guy from playing his bagpipes everyday, 24-hours a day. I mean look at him. On what planet is that racket considered music? Ugh! I cannot take it anymore, so I'm gonna hit his bagpipe with my Inflate-inator! Yeah, I-I know, It's basically the opposite of my old Deflate-inator. But I can't concentrate with all that noise! I was lucky to come up with that. But when that bagpipe blows up I will once again be able to hear the usual din ringing through the city streets. Like, uh, car alarms, and babies crying, and -inators blowing up. (Perry flings himself off the -inator, and punches Doofenshmirtz)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Pushing Linda towards the fence) Come on! Come on! Come on! This time I've got an eyewitness. (gestures toward the house with eyes closed) Go on. Go on. Tell my mom everything!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (with disdain) Well, when the empty window feels like talking, you let me know. (walks away)

Name: Woman
Dialog: There it is, I dropped my penny. Did you say something dear?

Name: Monty
Dialog: How was your meal dad?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Absolutely delicious. What a great new place.

Name: Monty
Dialog: I know, right? Carl found it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well then, let me just say thank you, to the chef. Thank you for that delicious meal.

Name: Chef
Dialog: You're most welcome, so glad you enjoyed it.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Dad, isn't there something you wanted to say to Carl as well?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Of course, what was I thinking? Don't be rude Carl, thank the chef.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Thank you.

Name: Chef
Dialog: I like this table, and to show my gratitude, dessert is on the house. Now if you'll excuse me, I must go fire a member of staff. Luchenzo! Come here!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There, you see? A little gratitude goes a long way. Pay attention Carl, you could learn something.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Under his breath) ...really learn something from you, you-

Name: Monty
Dialog: Just chill out, I got another idea.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Check you out Perry the Bloat-apus. Hehehe! (Doofenshmirtz inflates as well) Well, uh, this is awkward. Seriously, you're gonna-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, I'm so glad I had this Helipad installed.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Upsy-daisy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Dragging Linda out by the arm) No really, I swear the old lady is there in the window right now! I swear!

Name: Linda
Dialog: No need to swear. I'm coming.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There she is! (points toward where the window is)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (sees nothing but a bonsai tree in the window) Funny Candace, I could swear your "old lady" looks just like a house plant. (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What!?

Name: Woman
Dialog: (Watering the plant) There you go. A little thirsty weren't you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, wow. Aw man. We're not getting anywhere. How 'bout we take a time out?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, your hat has a pressure release valve? Wow, so that's what the inside of a platypus smells like? Could've gone my whole life without knowing that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! Aw man, another inator bites the dust, and I'm stuck listening to Jerky McIrritating across the street now.

Name: Man
Dialog: What's that? Oh I'm sorry, I'll stop. I didn't realize I was disturbin' you. Cheery-bye!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh, well I guess I might have over-thought that solution, just a little bit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ahhh! Curse you Perry the Platypus!

Name: Carl
Dialog: This had better work.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Don't worry Carl, once you save my dad's life, there's no way even he could avoid thanking you for it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I hope for your sake you're right. You know it's funny how no one's noticed a grand piano dangling precariously over our table.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Well, I also tied up a couple of violins over there so it would seem like a theme. Alright, listen so when my dad returns, I'll excuse myself, and cut the rope, and you push my dad out of the way of the falling piano. Got it?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Let's get to that dessert menu.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Excuse me dad, it's my turn. I'll be right back, you guys start.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sure, sure. Thank you for not making us wait. Heh. That bathroom attendant was lovely, he gave me mints and some floss. I-I just couldn't thank him enough.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Watch out sir!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Dad! Carl! A-Are you alright?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I'm uh, I'm fine.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm alright too sir.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Wow, Carl, you saved my dad's life.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, It's a shame he couldn't save the table too. Let's go find the host--

Name: Monty
Dialog: Wait. Whoa! What? Seriously?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Dad, aren't you going to thank him?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, well I didn't realize I hadn't. Thank you for pointing that out to me Monty.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Dad!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, uh, yes, right. Thank you Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh well, more dessert for us.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, it's different this time, she promised to come down and meet us!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Right, my expectations have been completely reversed.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No you'll see, she'll explain everything. Everything!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Heeheeheeheehee... (the woman comes out) Yes! See? Mom, Lady. Lady, Mom. Now tell her everything!

Name: Cop
Dialog: (Speaking to the woman) You have the right to remain silent, anything you say--

Name: Peggy
Dialog: Take your hands off me, copper! I know my rights! Sorry Candace, water the plant for me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't understand. What's going on?

Name: Cop 2
Dialog: Police matter miss.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What could that sweet old lady have possibly done?

Name: Cop 2
Dialog: That "sweet old lady" is Peggy "The Pyramid" McGee, the notorious ring leader of Danville's biggest pyramid scheme.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pyramid scheme?

Name: Cop 2
Dialog: That's right, she's been selling these all over town. See? These are just flat triangles, painted in perspective. That's fraud.

Name: Peggy
Dialog: I'll be out before the time her mom serves pie!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow Candace, I can't believe it. A pyramid scheme right under our noses!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Flatly) Yeah, imagine that.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Hey.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey yourself.

Name: Monty
Dialog: I thought, uh...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, so did I. But then I figured I couldn't leave you here to suffer alone.

Name: Monty
Dialog: That's what I like. Thoughtful, and dismissive simultaneously.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Being tossed around like a beach ball) Nooo! Wait. Wait. Wait. Is that the Love Sandals? Ohh! Hey, oh, watch the hands lady. Heey!
